# sendio_suppression (Resource)

An address on the team's suppression list: no email is sent to it until the suppression is removed (destroyed) or expires.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendio_suppression" "legal_hold" {
  email   = "someone@example.com"
  comment = "Asked by legal not to email"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The suppressed address. Changing it creates a new suppression.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Note kept with the suppression (at most 500 characters).
- `expires_at` (String) When the suppression lapses (RFC 3339, in the future). Changing it creates a new suppression.
- `origin` (String) Why the address is suppressed: `manual` (default), `bounce`, `soft_bounce` (expires after 24 hours unless `expires_at` is set), `complaint`, `invalid` or `block`. Changing it creates a new suppression.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the address was suppressed.
- `id` (String) Suppression id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By id or by email address
terraform import sendio_suppression.legal_hold someone@example.com
```
